targets.doc/signature_limit.md:
# Signature limit

The single-signature purchase limit is one thousand (1000) EUR, as stated in the CFO directive of 1 July 2026. [[cite:obs-b75eb6febbac77286c9b737a1fa1b3edb4671acb "Until further notice a single signature suffices for purchases up to one thousand (1000) EUR only."]]

Where the CFO directive and the procurement policy differ, the CFO directive applies. [[cite:obs-b75eb6febbac77286c9b737a1fa1b3edb4671acb "Until further notice a single signature suffices for purchases up to one thousand (1000) EUR only."]]

Therefore, the single-signature purchase limit is one thousand (1000) EUR according to the CFO directive. [[cite:obs-b75eb6febbac77286c9b737a1fa1b3edb4671acb "Until further notice a single signature suffices for purchases up to one thousand (1000) EUR only."]]
